headlines.title: Stocks surge as ‘blue tsunami’ puts political uncertainty to rest
headlines.description: Stocks had their best day in months. Shares of Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Tesla declined, however, after the billionaire spent heavily to support Republicans.

headlines.title: Democrats won on affordability. Whether they can deliver it is a different story.
headlines.description: Democrats won historic electoral victories on a pledge to make life more affordable, an issue that united voters across political and demographic divides.

headlines.title: Oil prices drop below $100 as midterms fuel hope for an end to the Iran war
headlines.description: Crude had traded as high as $118 a barrel Friday. Diesel futures also tumbled to their lowest point since August.

headlines.title: What Midterm Election Results Could Mean for Consumer Prices
headlines.description: With Democrats winning control of the House and Senate, voters signaled their unhappiness with the economy and the surging consumer and fuel prices. NBC’s Brian Cheung joins TODAY on what’s next after the shift in power.

headlines.title: Holiday Grocery Baskets: Which Are Worth the Money?
headlines.description: Thanksgiving is just a few weeks away which means grocery stores are serving up major ways to save on your holiday feast. NBC’s Vicky Nguyen joins TODAY with a look at the offerings from Lidl, Target, Amazon, Sam's Club and more.

headlines.title: Smart Ways to Navigate Early Holiday Shopping Deals
headlines.description: With affordability top of mind for many families, shoppers are looking for smarter ways to get those holiday gifts this year, including jumping on early holiday deals before the gift-giving season ramps up. NBC's Vicky Nguyen stops byTODAY to share where to find the best prices and when is the best time to buy.

headlines.title: Best Travel Deals to Snag Before the End of the Year
headlines.description: Whether you’re looking to escape the cold or embrace the holiday season, travel expert Mark Ellwood joins TODAY to share all the best deals and getaway destinations, including Mystic, Connecticut, Cabo San Lucas, Mexico, Lutsen, Minnesota, and more.

headlines.title: In top Senate race states, gas and grocery costs are rising faster than the national average
headlines.description: President Donald Trump’s promise to tame inflation has collided with higher costs in states that will determine if Democrats will win control of Congress.

headlines.title: Tracking U.S., state and county gas prices, in maps and charts
headlines.description: Are gas prices declining? NBC News is tracking national, state and county prices at the pump.

headlines.title: Gas cost calculator: How much have higher gas prices cost you?
headlines.description: Americans have spent an estimated $80 billion more in gas since the Iran war started. According to an NBC News analysis, drivers who fill up twice a month paid anywhere from $20 to $300 more for gas.

headlines.title: Oil prices slide in biggest drop since July on hope for more Iran talks
headlines.description: President Donald Trump twice replied “No” when he was asked if the U.S. plans to resume strikes on Iran after the midterms.

headlines.title: Chili’s customers suffer burns after sipping margaritas mistakenly made with cleaning agent
headlines.description: Three customers and two workers were burned on their mouths, officials said. The restaurant has since reopened and hasn’t been fined.
